:::: {.columns}

::: {.column width="55%"}
I study conflict and trade, with a particular interest in their spatial
dimensions. My main areas of expertise are

- Experimental Economic Geography
- Observational Studies of Conflict
- Applied Economic Theory

My research combines formal theory, historical data, and laboratory experiments.
